routes.name: Entry Visa (business, work, humanitarian, other)
routes.summary: Apply through a Sudan embassy with a sponsor letter. Embassy in Washington lists USD 154 and up to 10 working days. Check the current travel situation before planning.

other: Sponsor letter from a certified company
Humanitarian workers need a Humanitarian Aid Commission certificate
Non-US passport holders applying in the US need a valid US residence permit
Fee and rules come from one embassy and may differ elsewhere

routes.processing: Up to 10 working days, per the embassy

sources.label: Embassy of Sudan, Washington: Entry Visa
